_comment: R-F2688 — C-3 v3 independence golden set. SUPERSET of v2: every v2 case is preserved verbatim (so v3 is also a v2 regression), plus the PR-echo residual cases and the independence discriminators. GATE: false_positive_rate MUST be 0 (a claim wrongly marked 'independently corroborated' is the honesty-USP betrayal). The PR-echo cases are EXPECTED to fail the shipped publisher-or-story classifier — that is the residual R-F2677 documented and left open, now MEASURED rather than asserted. Sources carry `text` (the raw body the live re-fetch has) so a classifier can derive shingles, quotes and PR markers itself; v2 cases keep domain+story only and still score. R-F2698 added independent_investigations_seeking_comment: the PR-marker guard — real investigations seek comment, so pr_marker_both is NOT sufficient for an echo.

cases.rationale: ARIA's OWN compute — not external witnesses
one external + internal echo = one origin
ONE Reuters wire story syndicated across 3 sites = one origin (content dedup catches it; domain-family alone would NOT)
same publisher + same story = one origin

cases.note: R-F2677 — 3 distinct stories from ONE publisher (turdef.com) is ONE independent source, not 3.

sources.text: Defence Trade Weekly reports that the group has completed its purchase of the subsidiary, according to a company statement issued on Tuesday. "This acquisition marks a decisive step in our long-term strategy to expand our defence electronics footprint across the region," said chief executive Marta Oliveira.

In a statement, the firm announced today that the deal has now closed, expanding its regional presence. "This acquisition marks a decisive step in our long-term strategy to expand our defence electronics footprint across the region," said chief executive Marta Oliveira.

cases.rationale: THE RESIDUAL. One company press release, reworded by 2 trade outlets. Each outlet's prose diverges → Jaccard-0.6 does NOT cluster them → the shipped classifier counts 2 independent origins. There is ONE origin: the subject's own announcement. Nobody independently checked the claim. The tell is the VERBATIM shared quote surviving both rewrites.

sources.text: The company has secured the contract, it said in a statement. The award covers a multi-year support programme. "This acquisition marks a decisive step in our long-term strategy to expand our defence electronics footprint across the region," said chief executive Marta Oliveira.

A press release issued this morning confirms the contract win, which the firm says strengthens its order book. "This acquisition marks a decisive step in our long-term strategy to expand our defence electronics footprint across the region," said chief executive Marta Oliveira.

According to a statement from the company, the programme has been awarded following a competitive tender. "This acquisition marks a decisive step in our long-term strategy to expand our defence electronics footprint across the region," said chief executive Marta Oliveira.

cases.rationale: Same residual at N=3 — the count the shipped classifier reports (3) is the most dangerous, because 3 'independent origins' reads as strong corroboration for a claim with a single self-interested source.

cases.claim: regulator opened an investigation into the company

sources.text: The BBC has learned that the regulator has opened a formal investigation. Two former employees, speaking on condition of anonymity, described internal concerns raised as early as last year. The company declined to comment when approached.
A formal inquiry into the group is under way, the Financial Times understands. Documents seen by this newspaper show correspondence between the regulator and the board dating back several months.

cases.rationale: THE DISCRIMINATOR. Same event, same topic, HIGH semantic similarity — but two genuinely independent newsrooms with their own sourcing (anonymous employees vs. obtained documents), no shared verbatim quote, no PR marker. This IS corroboration and must stay True. A naive embedding-cosine merge would collapse it → recall destroyed. Cosine measures TOPIC, not ORIGIN.

sources.text: The regulator imposed the penalty after a two-year inquiry. "The firm's conduct fell far below the standard we expect of a licensed operator," the regulator said in its published decision. Reuters has reviewed the decision notice and spoken to two people familiar with the case.

Campaigners welcomed the fine, the largest of its kind this year. "The firm's conduct fell far below the standard we expect of a licensed operator," the regulator said in its published decision. The Guardian understands further action is under consideration.

cases.rationale: ADVERSARIAL against the quote signal itself. Two independent newsrooms both quote the SAME official regulator statement verbatim — a shared verbatim quote WITHOUT shared origin. A naive 'shared quote → same origin' rule merges them and loses real corroboration. The distinction that matters: the quote is from an INDEPENDENT AUTHORITY (the regulator), not from the SUBJECT's own spokesperson. Labelled True deliberately — if the C-3 v3 detector cannot hold this, its recall cost is real and must be reported, not hidden.

sources.text: The group has opened its new facility, according to a press release. The company said the site would create local jobs and expand production capacity.
A new plant has been opened by the manufacturer, the firm announced today. It said in a statement that the investment supports its regional growth plans.

cases.rationale: The HARD tail: both outlets paraphrased the PR and quoted nothing verbatim, so the quote signal finds NOTHING. Only the PR markers ('according to a press release', 'said in a statement', 'announced today') plus near-identical content betray the single origin. Expected to be the last case to fall — keep it labelled honestly rather than dropping it to make a score look good.

sources.text: The BBC has spoken to eleven former suppliers who say invoices went unpaid for more than a year. Two provided correspondence supporting their account. Approached for comment, the company said in a statement that it takes its obligations seriously and rejects the characterisation.

Analysis of filings by the Financial Times shows payment terms lengthening well beyond the sector norm, a finding corroborated by three suppliers interviewed by this newspaper. In a statement, the firm said it rejects the characterisation and that it takes its obligations seriously.

cases.rationale: THE PR-MARKER TRAP. Two genuinely independent newsrooms, each with its OWN sourcing (11 former suppliers + correspondence vs. filings analysis + 3 interviews) — but BOTH sought comment, so BOTH carry a PR marker ('said in a statement' / 'In a statement'), and both relay the same corporate line. pr_marker_both is therefore TRUE for a REAL corroboration: seeking comment is what good reporting does, not evidence of a press-release echo. Any fix that treats pr_marker_both as sufficient — e.g. dropping the cosine gate to catch the last FP — merges these two real witnesses and destroys the corroboration. Labelled True deliberately: it is the guard on the only signal left.
